messages:
samir: Quick heads-up: scheduling a short maintenance on apac-edge (edge-east-1) tonight 23:00-00:30 JST. Goal: NVMe controller micro-patch + TOR switch micro-reboot. We'll run cohort drains to avoid big capacity cliffs.
elaine: Thanks. Cohorts or single-rack? Any heatmap on tenants that will be affected?
samir: Cohorts of 3 hosts (approx 6 GPUs) per wave, 12m between waves. We'll prefer low-util tenants first based on the 'noisy' tag. Canaries at 23:00. Target to keep hosted pool capacity >= 80%.
dave: FYI for CS/oncall: ask long-running evals to pause between 22:30-00:45 UTC. Last time we hit retry storms when PDE jobs overlapped drains.
oncall: What routing/fallbacks are enabled? Is there automatic region shift or only to dedicated-burst?
samir: We have an ingress routing policy that will attempt local hosted -> dedicated-burst if p95 latency exceeds 300ms or node drain in progress. Snippet below for ops: 
```
route "apac-east" {
  prefer = ["hosted"]
  fallback = ["dedicated-burst"]
  latency_threshold_ms = 300
  request_type_routing = true
}
```
carla: Cost blast warning: routing 30% traffic to dedicated-burst for 90m estimated at ~$900 extra on top of baseline (depends on commit utilization).
elaine: Can we be more surgical? Move batch/embeddings only and keep interactive chat on hosted until it's unstable.
samir: Yes. We'll set request_type_routing: batch/emb->dedicated-burst, chat->hosted-with-fallback. Also disable retries for batch jobs during the window to avoid compounding traffic.
dave: Ops checklist (concise):
- 22:50 UTC: final comms to CS + status page
- 23:00 UTC: canary cohort drain & patch
- monitor p99/p50, ingress error rate, KV cache hit-rate
- 23:12 UTC: if stable, proceed next cohort
- post-cohort: kvseed and cache warmup (see command)
- rollback if sustained error_rate > 1% for 8m
oncall: Add automated rollback trigger: error_rate > 1% for 8m OR p95 > 500ms for 10m -> revert routing and un-drain nodes.
infra-bot: maintenance scheduled: id=mtn-20250410-421, window=2025-04-10T14:00Z-15:30Z, owner=samir
carla: @maria can you publish a short status page blurb: "scheduled edge maintenance may cause short-lived increases in latency for APAC customers" and DM top-tier customers with SRE contact?
maria: Will do. I'll also post a small note in CMP and tag the impacted customers.
samir: Safe drain command for the cohort (use only operator access):
```
# safe drain avoiding eviction-critical pods
redwoodctl node drain cohort-east-03 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=240 --label-selector='!eviction-critical'
```
dave: After each cohort, run kvseed: `kvseed --region apac-east --pool hosted --ratio 0.5` and watch token cost.
elaine: I'll handle racks 1-3 (first half). @dave you take 4-6 and billing watch.
dave: Got it. I'll also open a temporary cost alert: dedicated-burst-spend > +20% baseline -> notify #finance.
oncall: Logging: enable ingress-proxy debug for canary cohorts only for 15m, then revert to info.
samir: Last comms at 22:50 UTC in this thread. Ping me if any blockers. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
